output_list.criticism: The integer overflow in mintToken is a critical vulnerability that allows attackers to mint tokens to the owner's account.
The integer overflow in transfer allows attackers to cause a denial of service attack by overflowing balanceOf[_from].
The integer overflow in transferFrom allows attackers to cause a denial of service attack by overflowing balanceOf[_from].
The integer overflow in approve allows attackers to cause a denial of service attack by overflowing allowance.
The integer overflow in burnFrom allows attackers to cause a denial of service attack by overflowing balanceOf[_from].
